title: Add Vercel deployment guide for MSW and Server modes
body:
Documents how to deploy ObjectStack applications to Vercel in two modes: MSW (static SPA with in-browser kernel) and Server (Serverless Functions with real database).

### Changes

- **`content/docs/guides/deployment-vercel.mdx`** — New guide covering:
  - **MSW mode**: Vite SPA deployment — kernel bootstrap in browser, MSW Service Worker setup, `vercel.json` with SPA rewrites, monorepo config
  - **Server mode (Next.js)**: `@objectstack/nextjs` catch-all route handler with kernel singleton pattern
  - **Server mode (Hono Edge)**: `HttpDispatcher`-based routing on Vercel Edge Functions
  - Environment variables, runtime mode switching (`?mode=msw|server`), deployment checklists, feature comparison table
- **`content/docs/guides/meta.json`** — Added `deployment-vercel` to Operations section
- **`content/docs/guides/index.mdx`** — Added guide to Operations table

### Key patterns documented

MSW mode (`vercel.json`):
```json
{
  "framework": "vite",
  "build": { "env": { "VITE_RUNTIME_MODE": "msw" } },
  "rewrites": [{ "source": "/(.*)", "destination": "/index.html" }]
}
```

Server mode (Next.js catch-all):
```typescript
// app/api/[...objectstack]/route.ts
import { createRouteHandler } from '@objectstack/nextjs';
const handler = async (...args) => {
  const kernel = await getKernel();
  return createRouteHandler({ kernel, prefix: '/api' })(...args);
};
export { handler as GET, handler as POST, handler as PATCH, handler as DELETE };
```
